title: Monitoring Vehicle Pollution and Fuel Consumption Based on AI Camera System and Gas Emission Estimator Model
summary: A YOLOv5-based camera pipeline estimated vehicle class, location and speed, then fed speed/class to an emission model; against BrnoCompSpeed LiDAR/GPS ground truth the speed mean relative error was 5.59%, with reported emission/fuel error estimates. This is dataset-based engineering validation, not direct pollutant measurement. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
